subject: Post-call: Eval charter, gated roadmap & owners for FinoSys POC
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finosys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Eval charter, gated roadmap & owners for FinoSys POC

Alex — thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap and a concrete next-steps proposal so we can lock the kickoff window and get procurement the right artifacts.

Recap (what we heard):
- Goal: Embed LLM-based triage + routing for support tickets and quick KB answers (reduce TTR, accelerate resolution).
- Primary success metric: 30% reduction in average time-to-first-response (TTR) for triaged cases during test load.
- Secondary metrics: precision of auto-classified intents > 90% on the labeled eval set; 95th pct latency < 400ms at 50rps sustained.

Proposed gated evaluation (4-week sprint):
- Week 0 (onboarding, security): data access & SSO, network allowlist, SOC2 evidence + NDA sign.
- Week 1 (integration): model endpoint integration, sample inference runs, baseline metrics.
- Week 2 (stress & scenario tests): run concurrent traffic patterns, evaluate accuracy on curated 1k-case set.
- Week 3 (readout & next-steps): final readout, cost/latency tradeoffs, recommendation and handoff.

Owners (we recommend):
- Redwood PM / Engagement lead: Hannah Schmitt (me) — overall cadence, readout.
- Customer success / onboarding: Marissa Cole — day-to-day ops, verification.
- Solutions engineering: Jonas Weber — model tuning, integration support.
- Redwood infra eng: Vivek Kulkarni — any VPC/private endpoint or network rules.

Key asks for FinoSys to confirm by EOD Thursday:
1) Access to a 1,000-case labeled eval sample (CSV or JSONL).
2) The primary slack/zoom contact and procurement contact (we heard Priya Singh might handle SOW/contract).
3) Any required compliance evidence beyond SOC 2 (data residency, retention windows).
4) Preferred weekly check-in day/time (we normally do Thu 10am PT).

Attachments: mutual action plan (first draft) + data spec template. Please confirm whether those look OK and what else procurement needs. If you approve the plan we can provision a kickoff slot for week of Jul 24 and share calendar invites.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112

Attachments: FinoSys_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (1 page - outline), FinoSys_Data_Specs.xlsx (schema template)
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finosys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <psingh@finosys.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 12:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Eval charter, gated roadmap & owners for FinoSys POC

Hannah — great recap, thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria: the team is comfortable with the TTR reduction target but would like to define the accuracy bar as intent precision >= 92% on the labeled sample instead of 90%. Can Redwood confirm whether that’s realistic given model choices?

2) Data: we can share a de-identified 1,000-case JSONL (fields: ticket_id, text, label) by Friday EOD. We will also include an example of our conversational idempotency keys and metadata schema.

3) Security/compliance: procurement (copied Priya) wants to see SOC 2 Type II report and a short note on retention — default retention is 90 days, but we need to understand Redwood’s data handling for logs and KV cache. Also our legal team typically runs a standard SOW + 60-day NDA before infra access.

4) Weekly check-ins: Thu 10am PT works for the core stakeholders.

If you can confirm the owner roster and propose a kickoff meeting time the week of Jul 24 (we prefer Tue/Wed mornings PT), we’ll route the internal approvals.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Product, FinoSys
alex.chen@finosys.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 15:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call: Eval charter, gated roadmap & owners for FinoSys POC

Hannah / Marissa — a few technical notes we should include before we send the M.A.P to procurement: 

- Network: if FinoSys wants a VPC endpoint we’ll need the CIDR ranges and a list of egress ports. If they go hosted we still need to allow outbound to our serving endpoints (TLS 443) and IPs (I’ll paste the list).
- Data format: JSONL is perfect; for 1k cases please include the original ticket text + any metadata you want the model to consider (product, priority). We’ll treat the labels as ground truth for our eval harness.
- Metrics: I recommend adding a cost-sensitivity gate — e.g., average token cost target <= $0.0009/token for the evaluation scenario — since model choice will affect recommendations.

Planning suggestion: keep the 4-week gated sprint but we should aim to start onboarding the week of Jul 24 with a 60-minute kickoff focused on network/auth and deliverables. I will prepare a short runbook and a lightweight dashboard (Grafana) for the readout.

I’ll draft the infra checklist and drop it into the Drive folder.

— Jonas
Solutions Engineer
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finosys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + Kickoff invite (week of Jul 24)

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Priya. We updated the MAP to reflect the 92% intent precision gate and added the cost-sensitivity target Jonas recommended. Attached: FinoSys_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (annotated) and the data spec template.

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Jul 25 2028, 10:00am PT (we chose Tue to give your procurement a day to review). If that does not work we can do Wed 9am PT or Thu 10am PT. Calendar invite attached (Kickoff_Calendar_Invite.ics).

What we’re provisioning from Redwood for the onboarding session:
- A dedicated engagement channel (Slack) for runbook/Q&A.
- A temporary dev key and sandbox endpoint for integration (expires after the POC).
- A readout dashboard and the eval harness (Grafana + CSV export).

Next steps for FinoSys: drop the eval sample to the Drive folder, confirm procurement contact and NDA window. Once Priya confirms we’ll route the SOC2 link and the SOW template to contracts.

Link to MAP + runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-FinoSys-POC
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2349

Thanks — Hannah

Attachments: FinoSys_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf, FinoSys_Data_Specs.xlsx, Kickoff_Calendar_Invite.ics
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finosys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <psingh@finosys.com>
Cc: contracts@finosys.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + Kickoff invite (week of Jul 24)

Hannah — this all looks good. Priya, I’ve looped contracts to get the SOW/NDA moving; they typically want us to sign a 60-day mutual NDA and prefer the SOW to be our standard format (we can accept Redwood template with minor edits).

Two quick questions for Redwood:
1) Can you provide the SOC 2 Type II summary link (or an internal contact to share the report under NDA)?
2) For data retention: can you confirm logs/kv cache retention policy during the POC (we need to ensure PII is not retained beyond sandbox use)?

Also, Thu 10am PT weekly check-ins are fine — we’ll use that cadence for rapid syncs and mid-sprint blockers. Looking forward to the kickoff on Tue/Wed (will confirm which once contracts responds).

Thanks — Alex
